security._comment_csp: connect-src allows the dev API on localhost plus the prod AEGIS subdomains. Update before shipping if the server lives elsewhere.
security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:8080 https://*.aegisimaging.ai ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: AEGIS Uploader — anonymize and upload DICOM studies
bundle.longDescription: Desktop client for the AEGIS imaging platform. Anonymizes DICOM studies locally per PS3.15 Annex E before secure upload. PHI never leaves the operator's workstation in identifiable form.

linux._comment_webkit: Tauri 2 defaults to webkit2gtk-4.1 on Linux; pinning explicitly here is harmless and future-proofs against the default changing.

plugins._comment_updater_key: REPLACE_WITH_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_BEFORE_FIRST_SIGNED_BUILD — generate via `pnpm tauri signer generate`. Public key goes here. Store the private key + password in 1Password (and as TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY / TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD GitHub Secrets) BEFORE the first signed release. Until then the updater will refuse to apply any update.
